title: Meet the potter wasp, the insect that builds its own mudhouse
description: Distinguished by their pot-shaped mud nests, Potter wasps are solitary insects that exhibit incredible craftsmanship. Using a combination of mud and saliva, they build their homes with care. Following egg-laying, the females venture out to capture caterpillars, which serve as nutritious meals for their growing larvae. Their activities help maintain ecological balance and contribute to effective pest management across diverse environments.

title: In 1922, Olaus Murie entered Alaska to study caribou and wildlife ecosystems
description: Olaus Murie began studying Alaskan caribou in 1922, which influenced ecological wildlife understanding. His brother Adolph later investigated wolves and Dall sheep, challenging predator control assumptions. Adolph's research examined species interactions within the wider ecosystem of Mount McKinley. This work helped shift park management away from viewing predators solely as pests. The Muries' ecological approach continues to inform Denali's conservation efforts today.

The company wants payroll reduced before its second quarter starts on September 1. title: Vikram’s Lar Gibbon video sparks forest probe; 1 animal dead and 2 sent back to Erode
description: Actor Vikram's video featuring an endangered gibbon has prompted a forest department investigation. Officials are examining how the animal reached the actor and its ownership chain. A third gibbon, linked to the same breeder, reportedly died without notification. The surviving gibbons have been returned to Erode as the inquiry continues. This case highlights concerns regarding the legal movement of exotic animals.

title: Speaking Marathi must for cab drivers in Maharashtra, violations to cost permit

Failing to demonstrate this skill could lead to permit suspension.  This directive applies to auto-rickshaws, taxis, and app-based cab operators.  The state government aims for better communication and passenger safety.

title: How Ukraine combined missiles & drones in a 'unique' strike on Russian stronghold
description: Ukraine reported a significant overnight strike on Russia's Novorossiysk naval base. Jet-powered drones and missiles successfully targeted air defense and port infrastructure. This attack disrupted vital grain export operations at two major terminals. Russian officials confirmed civilian casualties and damage to enterprises and buildings. The strike occurred amid broader exchanges of long-range attacks between both nations.

This series forms an essential part of the ICC World Test Championship cycle.

title: Air turbulence: That sudden stomach-drop feeling; why the body reacts before the brain
description: During flights, turbulence can create an unexpected sensation in the stomach as the body's balance system reacts instinctively. This quick reaction happens before the brain catches up with the airplane's movement, potentially leading to motion sickness and heightened stress. To ensure safety, it's essential to keep seat belts fastened and adhere to the crew's guidance. Gaining insight into this experience may alleviate fears associated with flying.

Many of those on board experienced discomfort, with some feeling faint from the heat. The aircraft eventually returned to the bay, and arrangements for a replacement flight were made to depart several hours later.

title: Can the govt take control of foreign-funded assets? FCRA Bill explained
description: The Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026, introduced in the Lok Sabha in March, proposes a new framework for managing foreign contributions and assets when an organisation’s registration is cancelled, surrendered or ceases. The government says the changes are intended to address administrative and legal gaps, while critics question the breadth of the proposed powers.
